issue.body:
This change allows user to disable GeoIP downloader using `elasticsearch.yml` and it deletes `.geoip_databases` index if downloader is disabled.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/76586

body:
> Can you please also make it possible to remove the index? :)

That makes sense, in linked PR I've added clean-up code that will delete `.geoip_databases` index when geoip downloader is disabled
